mohw_table_700ml.derived: kcal minus 4*sugar_g = 411.6 (full), 408.8 (half), 368.2 (light): the non-sugar part (tea, milk/creamer, pearls) is ~370-410 kcal.

drinks.sugar_levels_note:
董氏基金會 (John Tung Foundation) repeatedly found that stated 半糖 drinks are often much sweeter: one report (PTS news,
https://news.pts.org.tw/article/238135, year not confirmed) says over 60% of drinks claiming 半糖 were actually 7-8 分糖 and
16% of 232 sampled 半糖 teas had the same kcal as 全糖; another (UDN, https://health.udn.com/health/story/6037/2676720) quotes
the foundation director saying shops' 半糖 and 全糖 taste "about as sweet". Hence half's max is widened to 0.95 and the
MOHW 0.727 (itself a "7.3 分") is used as typ rather than 0.5. Since 2021-01-01 TFDA requires chain shops to label total sugar and kcal
(Taiwan News, https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/zh/news/4023689); use those labels when available.

source: Sum constrained by MOHW page 5 (see mohw_table_700ml): 658/588/525 kcal minus 4 kcal/g of listed sugar.

Split: judgement. No chain-shop table was fetched; 50嵐 large cup secondary figures 668-783 kcal full-sugar (cw.com.tw/article/5127474, TVBS supertaste 345348) are HIGHER than MOHW's 658, so max is allowed up to the 783 case.
Label gap: shop labels often exclude toppings; 董氏基金會 2019 found label vs actual kcal differences up to ~7x with toppings (PTS news 433548).
bubble_milk_tea.note: kcal for 全糖 at typ: 61.6*4 + 285 + 120 = 651 (MOHW 658). Hi case (75 g, 340, 190) = 830 kcal covers the 783 chain figure.
bubble_milk_tea.size_scaling: Scale all terms by size_ml/700. A 700 mL cup contains ice; the MOHW per-700 mL basis is assumed to be drink volume incl. ice. Unverified.
